name: shuvshow
description: Stream shuvshow browser comments to Claude Code as notifications, and publish snippets over MCP.

shuvshowUrl.title: shuvshow URL
shuvshowUrl.description: Base URL of your shuvshow server. Local default is http://localhost:8228; set your deployed instance (e.g. https://shuvshow.you.workers.dev) otherwise.

apiToken.title: shuvshow token
apiToken.description: Bearer token for a deployed shuvshow instance. Leave blank for a local server.
